summary: Meta AI's Alexandr Wang announced the release of Muse Spark 1.3, a new version of the Muse model line, available via Muse Code and the Meta Model API, described as stronger at agentic and coding tasks.

practices.reason: The post claims the new model is much stronger at agentic and coding tasks, but gives no benchmark figures to evidence the claim.
practices.quote: much stronger at agentic and coding with better usability.
